headline: Fox Completes $22 Billion Roku Acquisition
summary: Fox has completed a $22 billion acquisition of Roku to expand its digital reach. The deal combines traditional broadcasting assets with a major digital streaming platform.
why: Large media mergers restructure the streaming and entertainment landscape, altering competitive dynamics for advertising and content distribution.
